root_idea.summary: The central lexical orientation is dividing a whole into distinct portions.
root_idea.development: From partitioning come the ideas of a bodily member as a distinct part, dividing or distributing something into portions, and the Quranic plural referring to the Quran treated in fragments. Other historically attested branches are kept separate below.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular dictionary citation form عِضَةٌ rather than the Quranic plural surface form عِضِينَ.

senses.definition: A piece, part, or portion; in the Quranic expression, the Quran treated as divided into portions or fragments.
senses.usage_conditions: Attested in the plural form عِضِينَ in the expression describing acceptance of some of the Quran and rejection of some of it.
A Quran-attested interpretation of عِضِينَ in 15:91, treating the plural as falsehoods rather than portions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enchant or bewitch; عَضْوٌ is used as its verbal noun in this sense.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct verbal branch of عَضَا, not the Quranic noun عِضَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To understand wounds or have skill in dealing with them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the idiomatic expression كَانَ يَعْضُو الجِرَاحَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of dividing or distributing something into portions, including dismembering a slaughtered animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used in discussions of dividing an inheritance or other property when it is capable of partition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A limb, member, organ, or distinct bodily portion, including a substantial bone or flesh-and-bone part; also a component of a bow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The dual العُضْوَانِ can conventionally denote the male and female genital organs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A party, sect, or class of people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested with the plural عِضُونَ; this is a Classical Arabic group-meaning distinct from the Quranic use for portions or falsehoods.
A reported analysis of عِضُونَ as the plural of عِضَهٌ, with ه, rather than the Quranic plural of عِضَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sufficiency in clothing and food; عَاضٍ denotes a person possessing adequate clothing and food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the state, while the active-participle form denotes the person characterized by it.

cautions: The evidence preserves competing derivational analyses for عِضِينَ, associating it either with the root ending in و or with the related form written with ه; the artifact records the attested lexical readings without resolving that etymological question.
